tools.name: nebula_overview
tools.description: Read-only summary of Nebula (org, founders, services, industries, frameworks, counts). Use for a company snapshot; use nebula_search for ranked queries, nebula_list to browse titles/URLs, nebula_section for one exact path. Returns organization, people, services, industries, frameworks, counts, secti

tools.name: nebula_search
tools.description: Read-only ranked keyword search across approved Nebula KB sections. Use when you have a query; use nebula_list to browse without ranking, nebula_section for one exact path, nebula_overview for a summary. Returns query, results[{path,score,record}], total, offset, limit, nextOffset.

tools.name: nebula_list
tools.description: Read-only browse/enumerate of approved Nebula KB items (title, url, section, date when present). Use to page through a section or the full allowlist; use nebula_search for ranked queries, nebula_section for full record content, nebula_overview for a summary. Returns items[{title,url,section,date?}],

tools.name: nebula_section
tools.description: Read-only fetch of one exact section or record by dotted path. Sections: organization, people, services, industries, frameworks, research, externalAssets, answers, blogs. Use when you know the path from search/list; use nebula_overview for a summary, nebula_search to find paths, nebula_list to brows
